    --        @SchoolSessionID AS INT = 6399;


    /*------------------------------------------------------------------------------
      0. Tally table -- used for all date expansion (replaces the WHILE loops)
    ------------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
    IF object_id('tempdb..#Nums') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE #Nums;

    SELECT TOP (100) N = ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) - 1
    INTO   #Nums
    FROM   sys.all_objects AS a CROSS JOIN sys.all_objects AS b;

    CREATE UNIQUE CLUSTERED INDEX IX_Nums ON #Nums (N);
